documents.title: CSE Guide to the Honor Code
documents.summary: Department-wide honor-code guide for all CSE courses. It treats generative AI such as ChatGPT, LLaMA or Copilot like any other source, citing the university policy that AI output is someone else's work. It sets a resource-vs-solution and consult-vs-copy framework that syllabi use to mark each activity as allowed, allowed with citation, or not allowed, with worked ChatGPT/quicksort examples and a sample citation.
